sources.title: ViANLI: Adversarial Natural Language Inference for Vietnamese
sources.snippet: The MultiNLI (Multi-Genre Natural Language Inference) multinli dataset was developed to address some of the limitations of the Stanford Natural Language Inference (SNLI) dataset, including the problem of the data being relatively simple and easy for advanced machine learning models.
